skill_summary: Manage persistent synthetic enterprise service tickets through authenticated MCP operations.

directory.description: Query real synthetic people and category candidates; retain every duplicate name with its ID and team

create.description: Create an open ticket. Priority may be suggested for a new ticket; do not claim an enterprise system was repaired

assign.description: Assign a directory person ID. First assignment may be automatic; changing an existing assignee requires confirmation

resolve.description: Record user-provided resolution after confirmation; never invent actual enterprise repair evidence

questions.proposition: More than one person is affected

scale.context: work can continue with a workaround

parameter_sources.title: user text or primary planner preserving meaning
parameter_sources.priority: new ticket: weighted score; existing ticket: explicit confirmed choice

completion.create_and_assign: verified create receipt and requested assign receipt referencing the same ticket ID; closing is not required
completion.write: matching operation_id receipt and resource revision
